title: Kulaputtena dukkhā (2)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3 Saddhāpabbajitassa bhikkhave kulaputtassa ayam anudhammo hoti || yaṃ rūpe aniccānupassī vihareyya || || Vedanāya || || Saññāya || || Saṅkhāresu || || Viññāṇe aniccānupassī vihareyya || || pa || || [page 180] 180 KHANDA-SAṂYUTTA [XXII. 147. 4-5 4-5 -parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmīti || ||
